{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter to treatment arm only
data_treatment = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute number of responders and total patients
n_responders = data_treatment['responded'].sum()
n_total = len(data_treatment)

# Compute fraction
responded_fraction = n_responders / n_total

# Print all required values
print('Number of responders in treatment arm:', n_responders)
print('Total number of patients in treatment arm:', n_total)
print('Fraction who responded:', responded_fraction)

# Return the fraction
responded_fraction"}
